subject: ela
intro: Tenth graders determine a central idea of a text and analyze its development over the course of the text, including how it emerges and is shaped and refined by specific details; they provide an objective summary. The central idea is built and refined by the author's chosen details.

items.prompt:
Read.

Urbanization is accelerating. More than half the world now lives in cities, and that share is projected to keep rising.

What is the central idea, and how is it refined?

steps: Central idea: urbanization is accelerating; refined by the statistics.
So the central idea is that urbanization is accelerating, refined by the majority-urban fact and the projection.
solution.answer: Urbanization is accelerating, refined by the majority-urban statistic and projection.

steps: So: 'Urbanization is accelerating, with over half the world now in cities and the share projected to rise.'
solution.answer: 'Urbanization is accelerating, with over half the world in cities and rising.'

items.prompt: A central idea is shaped and refined by specific ____.
The main point of an informational text is the ____ idea.
An opinion-free retelling is an ____ summary.
